ctaHeading: Yarraville's landscapers are ready — let's grow your garden.
aboutText: With over 20 years of experience, LD Total Landscaping has been transforming outdoor spaces in Yarraville and surrounding areas. We specialise in bespoke garden design, high-quality construction, and ongoing maintenance to keep your property looking its best. Our team is committed to delivering personalised solutions that enhance the beauty and functionality of your landscape.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of landscaping services, from initial design concepts to full construction and regular maintenance. Our team ensures every project is tailored to your vision, using quality materials and sustainable practices.

services.title: Garden Design
services.desc: Custom designs to suit your lifestyle and property, with 3D visualisations for clarity.

services.title: Landscape Construction
services.desc: Expert building of retaining walls, paths, and garden beds using durable materials.

services.title: Lawn Installation
services.desc: Professional laying of turf or seeding for a lush, green lawn that thrives.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including pruning, weeding, and fertilising to keep your garden healthy.

services.title: Irrigation Systems
services.desc: Efficient water management solutions to keep your plants hydrated and conserve resources.

services.title: Outdoor Lighting
services.desc: Strategic lighting to highlight features and improve safety in your outdoor spaces.
